name: ISO/IEC 27001 (Annex A)
description: ISO/IEC 27001:2022 Annex A controls. Titles/descriptions are paraphrased — the standard's text is copyrighted and must not be stored verbatim.

controls.title: Policies for information security
controls.description: Information security policy and topic-specific policies are defined, approved, published, acknowledged, and reviewed at planned intervals.
controls.evidence_guidance: Active policies with version history, review dates and acknowledgment records.

checks.rationale: An active, reviewed, acknowledged infosec policy is the direct A.5.1 artifact.

controls.title: Inventory of information and other associated assets
controls.description: An inventory of information and associated assets, including owners, is developed and maintained.
controls.evidence_guidance: The maintained asset inventory with ownership verification.

checks.rationale: The shared Asset Inventory, actively maintained, is the inventory A.5.9 requires.
A.5.9 requires owners — ownership verification on assets evidences this.

controls.title: Access control
controls.description: Rules to control physical and logical access to information and assets are established based on business and security requirements.
controls.evidence_guidance: Access control policy plus role-based access records.

checks.rationale: The published access-control policy establishes the A.5.15 rules.
Role-based membership changes in the audit trail show the rules enforced.

controls.title: Information security in supplier relationships
controls.description: Processes are defined to manage information security risks associated with the use of suppliers' products or services.

checks.rationale: Annual supplier security reviews evidence the A.5.19 process operating.

controls.title: Incident management planning and preparation
controls.description: The organization plans and prepares for managing information security incidents with defined processes, roles and responsibilities.

checks.rationale: The published IR policy is the A.5.24 plan.
A documented notification procedure supports incident preparation.

controls.title: ICT readiness for business continuity
controls.description: ICT readiness is planned, implemented, maintained and tested based on business continuity objectives.

checks.rationale: A tested continuity exercise in the last year is the standard A.5.30 artifact.

controls.title: Information security awareness, education and training
controls.description: Personnel receive appropriate security awareness, education, training and regular updates relevant to their function.

checks.rationale: Annual training records directly evidence A.6.3.

controls.title: Management of technical vulnerabilities
controls.description: Information about technical vulnerabilities of systems in use is obtained, exposure evaluated, and appropriate measures taken.
controls.evidence_guidance: Vulnerability scans, remediation within SLA, verification rescans.

checks.rationale: Recurring scans obtain vulnerability information for systems in use.
Appropriate measures taken = high/critical findings addressed within SLA.
Rescan verification strengthens evidence that measures were effective.

controls.title: Configuration management
controls.description: Configurations, including security configurations, of hardware, software, services and networks are established, documented, implemented, monitored and reviewed.
controls.evidence_guidance: Configuration monitoring via scans; change records.

checks.rationale: Continuous scan schedules monitor configuration drift.
The audit trail records configuration/administrative changes.

controls.title: Logging
controls.description: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults and other relevant events are produced, stored, protected and analysed.

checks.rationale: An operative, append-only audit log is the A.8.15 artifact.

controls.title: Monitoring activities
controls.description: Networks, systems and applications are monitored for anomalous behaviour and appropriate actions taken.

checks.rationale: Recent completed ASM discovery evidences monitoring of networks and systems.
Active recurring schedules make the monitoring continuous.

controls.title: Independent review of information security
controls.description: The organization's approach to managing information security is reviewed independently at planned intervals or when significant changes occur.

checks.rationale: An annual independent penetration test is a standard independent review artifact.
